## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify any affected case IDs.

## Validation

- [ ] Repository validation passes (`python3 scripts/validate.py`).
- [ ] Relevant tests pass (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`).
- [ ] UI changes were checked on desktop and mobile, including reduced motion.
- [ ] Research claims, prompts, outcomes, and media provenance remain supported by source evidence.

Include commands and results, and explain any unchecked item. For video changes,
include frame rate, frame count, resolution, and source provenance.
